batting.name: SA Asnodkar
batting.dismissal: c DJ Hussey b Umar Gul

batting.name: SC Ganguly
batting.dismissal: c M Kaif b SK Warne

batting.name: AB Agarkar
batting.dismissal: c M Rawat b SR Watson

batting.name: DB Das
batting.dismissal: c SR Watson b Sohail Tanvir

batting.name: AB Dinda
batting.dismissal: c T Kohli b SR Watson

balls.text: fires that on  the blockhole on middle and leg, he only manages to push it towards mid-on
Free Hit: he gets across his stumps and paddles away a low full toss to fine leg
he oversteps, he digs it out to long-on

What was Warne thinking? He backs away and creams a low full toss to deep cover, he starts off for a second run but Tanvir isn't interested, the throw comes to the keeper, Saha throws it to Gul and warne lazily walks back to the crease totally unaware of what's going on, Gul breaks the stump and Warne still makes no effort to ground his bat
full on the pads, he mistimes his scoop but just beats Gul
the legstump's outta here! Gul this time pitches it up on middle and leg, Pathan goes for the wild slog, fails to get the pitch of the ball and loses his legstump which goes back a few yards
yorker, Warne makes room and digs it out just wide of the bowler
makes room but misses the ball, Pathan sets off quickly, dives at the crease and makes his ground before the under arm flick breaks the stumps, they steal a bye
makes room and digs out a low full toss past point, Agarkar does brilliantly at sweeper cover to pull it back
the high full toss, it screeches through to Pathan who deflects it off his thighs
not the best looking stroke but effective all the same, the ball is short, he stays at the crease and flat bats it over mid-off
the quicker one, he makes room slice it past the infield but mistimes it towards mid-off
slower ball, very well bowled as it deceives him, he makes room and decides to leave it but the ball wasn't wide enough to be called
hits a length outside off, he had the width to cream that past the infield but ended up placing it straight to cover
that's a waist high full toss, he pulls to deep square leg
on the roof! Shukla overpitches and Pathan stays at the crease and lofts through the line and clears long-off, they're looking for volunteers to get the ball back from the roof
swings across the line and carts it to deep midwicket, Hussey tumbles and just manages to pull it back
nearly gets himself out there, the slower ball foxes him and he just manages to check his stroke, the ball lobs high and falls in front of mid-off
holds the length back, pitches on off and middle and holds its line, Jadeja swings way too early and the ball pegs the offstump back
take that! He pitches it full and straight, Jadeja swings and just creams that past the bowler, he gets a boot to it but the defelction doesn't help as the ball scorches through
tempts him to go for the heave over midwicket but Pathan misses it completely, feet were rooted to the crease
fires it full and quick outside off, he fails to squeeze it out
opens the face of the bat and steers it down to third man
makes room again and scoops it down to extra cover, Ganguly is a little slow in running forward to catch it and the ball beats him, should have been taken actually
Free Hit: Jadeja is making the free hits cont today, he backs away and carves an overpitched delivery over cover, he angles his bat and that aids him in getting the elevation
oversteps! Ishant strives for more pace, he fires that on a yorker length but the ball was too quick for Jadeja to squeeze that out
pitches outside off and seams across slightly, he tries a cheeky glide but misses
full on the pads, he spreads his legs out and clips it wide of midwicket, Gul's persisting with the yorkers
full and fast outside off, he makes room and squeezes it out to Hodge at sweeper cover
makes room again and he cuts a good length delivery wide of point, third man runs across to cut it off
Free Hit: Jadeja makes full use of the free hit there as he makes room and scoops an overpitched delivery down leg high over long-on
oversteps, he whips it to fine leg
the yorker goes through the gap between his legs as he tries to whip it to the on side, Gul appeals for a caught behind, so signs yet of an edge
attempts a yorker, it's full on the pads and he digs it out to square leg
makes room and manages to dig out the yorker, Pathan sets off for a risky run but luckily for him Saha's underarm flick is wide
full on middle and off and he pushes it across the line to long-on
bowls a slower one, though he's cramped for room, he angles his bat and steers it  down to third man
mush better, spears in a yorker and Pathan just manages to dig it out to the offside
Agarkar feeds it on the danger area - full outside off -  and  Pathan obliges by lofting high over mid-off
the slower ball, he picks it well and clips it from outside off to the on side
full on middle and leg, he swipes it to long-on
gives him the charge and takes the aerial route, luckily the ball lands safe in the region of long-on
full on middle and leg, he makes room and pushes it firmly to long-on
he errs by dishing out a full toss, he takes a couple of paces down and creams it high over point
flights it on middle and off and he gets on his knee and heaves it over midwicket
pitches on a good length outside off, he drives it firmly to the sweeper cover
persists with the yorker, this time he digs it out to long-on
low full toss this time and he only manages to biff it straight to Hussey
fires in another yorker, he squeezes it out towards mid-off
holds the length back on legstump, he gets back and clips it in front of midwicket
strays wide down the legside, he attempts a glance but misses
lands on a yorker length, he pushes it to long-on
misfield! After the highs of a wicket, Umar Gul lets one slip through the gate at short fine leg, he makes a vain attempt at pulling it back

two for the over! Watson will feel rather aggrieved with that as he got a thick inside edge onto his pads. The ball swung in, Watson shaped to tuck it away very close to the pads, umpire Koertzen raises the finger, replays showed a thick edge
pitches outside off, he punches this to the offside
there's very little margin for error on this pitch, Gul attempts a yorker but it's a little too wide outside off, he squeezes it out and times it so well that it beats point in a flash

loss of concentration from Asnodkar as he shapes to club that over the on side, the ball comes on a lot quicker and hence he gets a thick top edge which spoons to Hussey at wide mid-off, that was a tame end to a good innings but he's done his job
gets an inside edge onto his pads and Asnodkar blazes down the track, superb running, this guy's impressive
full outside off, he creams that hard towards mid-off and risks a single, the throw was just a little wide
bad start, bangs it in short and directs it wide down the leg, side, he tries to pull but misses
full outside off, he bangs it down to long-off
Asnodkar gets better and better, he stays at the crease and delicately cuts a good length delivery down to third man, his placement is spot on as he beats point and short third man
poor ball from Ganguly, it lands on a length at a gentle pace and Asnodkar gets on his knee and slogs it over midwicket, one bounce and four
pitches on middle and leg, he gets across and tucks it down to midwicket
the slower ball, looked like a legcutter, he reads the flight early, gets on his knee and slogs it over short fine leg, good placement
good start, keeps it fractionally short, the bounce sits up on him as he punches down to point, they contemplate a single initially
pushed to the on side for a single
full and wide outside off, he stays at the crease, gets on his knee and carves that over extra cover, Shukla runs across from long-off but he can't get to it
pushed in faster, he works it to long-on
pitches on middle and leg and Pathan heaves it across the line over midwicket
chips it on the up but beats Hussey who flings himself to his left to pull off a blinder, that's a 50 for Asnodkar, not a bad debut at all
pitches that wide outside off and doesn't get it to turn, he drives but gets a thick outside edge which beats short third man
he shapes to cut square but mistimes it down to the cover, that's an expensive over - 15 off it
drives outside the offstump and places it wide of extra cover
drags the line closer to the offstump but this time he takes a single down to third man
three in a row! He gives him width outside off and the length is shorter, he plays the conventional square cut and the ball scorches past backward point
and another! Agarkar once again dishes out a half volley outside off and he drags his bat and scoops it over the vacant slip region, it was  a thick outside edge
nice shot, Agarkar overpitches on middle stump, he makes a bit of room and carves it high over extra cover
fires a yorker on middle and leg, he reads the length early and pushes it down to mid-off and sets off fast
that's fractionally short, Asnodkar picks the length early, gets on top of the bounce and heaves that over midwicket
gets forward and drives that softly in front of Shukla at point
adjusts to a fuller length and delivers that slightly wide outside off, he cuts but can't beat point
bangs in the bouncer, the hook doesn't quite come off well but he places it well in front of fine leg
pushes it full and quick, he digs it out firmly towards mid-off

Agarkar shoots back after conceding a six, he changes the pace of the ball, Kaif fails to read it early and tamely chips it back to Agarkar, he closes the face of the bat at the time of contact and hence mistimes it
Shot man! The ball lands on a good length and Kaif gives him the charge early, he lofts through the line and clears long-off
the yorker length, he swings across the line and gets an inside edge to fine leg
beats him, there was width outside off but Asnodkar failed to make contact, driving away from the body
pitches outside off, he uses his bottom hand and pulls along the ground to Hodge at deep square
pitches outside off and hits him on the pads just outside the line of offstump, Agarkar appeals
attempts another yorker and misdirects it down the leg side, he shapes to glance it fine but the ball clips the pad and beats the keeper Saha who dives in vain
tries to heave him over the onside but ends up getting a thick inside edge onto his pads, the ball rolls to the offside
fires in another yorker and though he puts it away to the onside, he nearly slides and falls over at the crease
fires in the inswinging yorker and he just manages to gets some bat on it, he takes off after placing it to mid-off and dives at the crease, the throw is wide
short and he shapes to pull, the ball comes on a lot quicker so he ends up placing it to midwicket
good start, lands it on a length on offstump and the ball grips, he gets back and defends
drags the line outside the offstump, the ball seams away and he slashes and misses
he goes for the cross batted swipe but luckily the top edge lands well clear of midwicket
the slower ball, he reads it early, gets on the backfoot and cuts square of the wicket and beats backward point
slightly shorter in length, he covers the line and defends
good comeback, he looks to glide that down to third man but the ball comes back in and beats him completely
that was a cracker, the ball lands on a good length on middle and Asnodkar stays at the crease and pulls that on the frontfoot over deep square leg, good timing
the length is slightly shorter outside off, Kaif swivels early to club that down the ground but places it straight to mid-on who's a bit deep
beats him, lands on the seam and straightens off a good length, Kaif pokes at it and misses
fuller and coming in with the angle, he gets behind the line and defends on the front foot
hits a good length outside off, he pushes it to the offside
pitched up outside the offstump, he leans forward and deliberately angles it down wide of first slip, the ball races to third man, good use of the soft hands by Kaif
gets it to skid through at middle stump height, he steers it down to point and a misfield allows a single
superb placement, the ball was fractionally too short outside off, it holds its line and Kaif gets on the backfoot and taps it off the meat of the bat to beat the gap between extra cover and mid-off
slightly shorter in length, he gets back and punches it on the 'V' towards mid-off
this one skids through at stump height and Kaif angles it down towards cover
loses his direction and slides wide down the leg side, he misses the glance
grants him width outside off, Dinda strives for that extra yard of pace but sprays it offline and Kaif scoops it over backward point
hits a good length on off and middle, he gets back and defends
slides on middle and leg, he gets across and tucks it behind square on the on side
timber! Smith gives him the charge and Ishant fires that on a good length on leg stump, he misses and the ball crashes onto the legstump. Smith tried to cart that over long-on but failed
full and wide and he carves it high down to third man on the first bounce
almost a return catch, the ball was full, Asnodkar mistimes it on the up and Ishant stretches out his left hand to catch that but the ball was too quick for him, the umpire takes  evasive action
pitches close to the pads, he shuffles and works it towards midwicket
Smith stays back at the crease and plays it rather late, he taps it towards cover and looks for a single, sends Asnodkar back
pitches it on a fullish length, he gets behind the line and drives to mid-off
gets across and defends it very softly back to the bowler, the ball rolls to the bowler
false shot, there was width and he flayed at it outside the offstump
interesting way to kick off your IPL campaign! It was short, Asnodkar gets in position to hook, the ball lobs off the glove and just clears the keeper's head
waits on it and plays the ball really late, he opens the face of the bat and dabs it to third man
Smith does a big swivel across his stumps and fails to put away a short delivery, mid-on picks it up
hits the deck early on and gets Smith on the backfoot straight away as he defends back to the bowler

catch of the tournament, surely! Dinda tries to clear the infield on the off side and there are two fielders converging towards it in the region of mid-off - Warne and Taruwar Kohli. They nearly collide but Kohli stretches out his left hand and pulls off a blinder and hangs on to it after Warne eventually collides with him. Several blue shirts crowd the pair and boy is Kohli delighted!
the attempted yorker turns into a low full toss, he pushes it down to long-on
full and swinging in, he digs it out to the on side
fires in another yorker and this creeps between his legs, they steal a bye off a fumble

only a matter of time... He digs out a yorker to deep square leg and the batsmen risk a second run, they take a chance with Jadeja's arm but the throw was quick and flat, Rawat whips off the bails and the third umpire wasn't required
the slow leg cutter, he stays at the crease and lofts over the infield but fails to get the desired pace or elevation to go for the maximum, Watson comfortably taks it at long-off
bowls a yorker outside off, he makes room but fails to dig it out
an excellent finish to the over as he bowls a yorker on middle and leg, he gets a thick inside edge onto his pads
full on off and middle, he pushes it to long-on
Saha walks across his stumps and attempts another paddle scoop, Trivedi follows him and dishes out a yorker on middle and off, it goes straight through and hits middle and off
full outside off, he pushes it across the line to long-on, this is getting tougher and tougher for Kolkata
walks across his stumps and plays a paddle scoop which just falls wide of Smith at short fine leg
Hussey's efforts go to dust as he exposes his stumps and tries to cart one over the on side, Trivedi bowls a yorker on the stumps and takes out the bails
squeezes out a yorker towards point, Hussey scampers to the other end and makes his ground
stretches his bat out and plays it one handed down to mid-on, the ball lobs off the top of the bat and falls safe
keeps it full again,he gives the charge and plays it to long-off
jams in the yorker, Das fails to dig it out but Hussey charges from the other end, the under arm flick is wide
high full toss, he's down the track and he manages to push it wide of midwicket
Tanvir comes round the wicket, he makes room and lofts over the bowler's head
full outside off and yet again it's only a single, this time to sweeper cover
keeps it full and gets it to curve back in, not quite the length to scoop it over the infield and they have to settle for a single
jams in the yorker outside leg, he squeezes it out to the on side
makes room and clubs a low full toss over the bowler, the timing wasn't enough to carry it through to a boundary
jams in the yorker and Das manages to dig it out, a misfield by Munaf allows the single
short of a length outside off, he steers it wide of point, Tanvir's throw is a little wide of the keeper and that allows them to scamper back for the second run
stays back and punches hard, short cover does well to intercept it and save a couple more runs
stays back and clips it wide of short fine leg
stays back to pull and appears to get an inside edge, Rawat appeals for a leg before
pushed back hard and straight and Pathan does well to slide and cut it off
flighted on middle and leg, he steps down  and lofts over midwicket

tucks it behind square on the onside, they set off for the second run but Shukla's struggling, the throw by Jadeja is flat and fast and Rawat whips off the bails, the third umpire has a look, Shukla's just an inch or so short
full on legstump, he clubs it hard down to long-off

just before the rope.... Ganguly takes a couple of paces down and lofts a full delivery with the turn to long-on, Kaif just manages to cup it before the rope and stays there for a few seconds, he's relieved he hasn't stepped over
holds the length back on middle and leg, he pushes this one on the walk to deep midwicket
slides on the pads and Hussey gets on his knee early and sweeps that with intent past short fine leg
gives it a bit of air outside off and Hussey dances down the track and lofts it over long-off, he made plenty of room for that
flighted on middle and leg, he gets down and sweeps to shirt fine leg

Pathan bowls that slightly short and Ganguly stays back at the crease and pulls against the turn, Smith runs forward from deep midwicket and appears to cup it just above the turf, Rajasthan celebrate but Ganguly isn't convinced, the third umpire has a look and gives Ganguly the benefit of the doubt
makes room again and cuts but Munaf's in the circle at point to cut it off
flighted on middle and leg, he turns it to the on side
makes room, Pathan follows him and bowls that on middle, he cuts wide of short third man and Munaf just manages to cut it off before the rope, the third umpire has a look
gets forward early and clips it to midwicket on the walk
fires this one quick on off and middle, he gets forward and taps it towards cover
he gets on his knee and sweeps just wide of short fine leg, good over by Warne despite the wide
slides on middle and leg, that's an easy single to deep midwicket
terrible delivery as he directs this so wide down leg that Rawat barely manages to get a glove to it
he stays back to the shorter delivery and clubs this with the turn to deep midwicket
pushes this one flatter, Ganguly softly tucks this to midwicket
slides on the pads, he softly glances it wide of short fine leg
lands on middle and leg, he closes the face of the bat and whips it behind square on the on side
Munaf overpitches on the pads and Ganguly makes room and carves it over the bowler's head, long-on runs across but the ball  beats him
makes room and pushes a full delivery outside off just wide of long-off,, the fielding is a little slack and they take a second run
he makes room and misses a swing at a full delivery outside off, Rawat fumbles and they take a bye
full outside off, he pushes it through the line to long-off
almost a wicket! It was a full ball on middle and leg and Ganguly managed to heave that  over square leg, Pathan takes the catch but steps over the rope with the momentum
the inswinging yorker, Hussey squeezes it out to third man
full on the pads, Hussey turns it towards long-off, singles won't cut it for Kolkata
that was a low full toss outside off and Ganguly forces it firmly towards Smith at long-off, they think of a second run
the slower ball this time and Ganguly only manages to chop it down towards point, he's trying to force the pace
much fuller, lands on middle and leg and Hussey hurriedly whips it off towards long-on
bowls that short of a length, forces Hussey on the backfoot as he tucks it softly to midwicket
backs away and taps a good length delivery down to deep cover, it was the offcutter from Trivedi
chases a fulll delivery which seams away after pitching, Rawat gets excited behind the stumps
makes room but Munaf squares him up with a yorker, Ganguly only manages an inside edge onto his pads and the ball rolls to the offside
holds the length back outside off, he taps it down to third man
he pushes a low full toss firmly back to the bowler and the ball nearly defects onto the stumps off Munaf's hands, Hussey was out of the crease, they pick a single to long-off
bowls a yorker outside off, he digs it out but doesn't place it well enough to pick up a single
full outside off, he gets across and pushes it wide of cover
yet another slower ball, gets forward and taps it to cover
short ball, just outside off, and Ganguly majestically smashes it straight over the bowler for six
Trivedi is sending down a lot of slower balls here, Hussey uses his wrists to send it to midwicket for a single, he wanted two but Ganguly wasn't interested
short again, drifts down leg
fuller ball, on off, driven down the ground to long-off for a single
slower ball, short again, Hussey clips it to leg for a single
outrageous shot that, short ball on leg, Hussey gives himself room and flatbats it powerfully to the long-on boundary
Ganguly defends to the off, another dot ball, that was an excellent over from Munaf
on leg, cramps him for room, Ganguly hits it to short cover again
pushed behind square on the on side to deep square leg
tapped to short cover
on the pads , glanced to fine leg
short of a length, cut back in, tapped to mid-off

full ball smashed back down the ground, crashes into the stumps at the other end, Hodge is out of the crease at the non-striker end, the bowler claims to have touched it and appeals for a run-out, and the third-umpire rules him out
another slower ball, very short , Hodge nudges it to midwicket for a single
short of a length on off, Hodge defends
another slower ball, on leg this time, Ganguly pushes it square on the on side, Kolkata 50 comes up
wide, slower ball from Trivedi, Ganguly attempts to dab it away, no contact
short ball, Ganguly gets his leg of of the way, pulls it over mid-on and it trickles away into the boundary
good start, no width, nice length, Ganguly taps it back
on a length, just outside off, Hodge defends it back down the pitch
Watson bowls the slow off cutter, Agarkar backs away to slog it but fails to pick the slower one, he gets a thick outside edge to Rawat, the pinch hitter tactic hasn't worked for Kolkata
makes room and cuts one away down to third man
finally Ganguly finds the gap, he makes room and slices a short of a length delivery wide of extra cover
tries to clip one through the on side but the ball clips his pads instead, Agarkar sets off for a run but he's wisely sent back
Watson digs in a short one, Ganguly swivels and fails to pull it away, his form continues to be scratchy
gets forward to drive and manages a thick inside edge to the on side
slams that hard past the bowler but the stumps get in the way, they manage a single off the deflection
attempts the yorker, Agarkar makes room and does well to squeeze it out past cover, the timing and placement was good and the quick outfield did the rest
makes room and drags that from middle stump and carves it over midwicket, it was more of a slog
another well directed bouncer, this one comes through quickly and he barely has enough time to get on his knee and evade it
hits a good length on middle and leg, he stays back and clips it hard to mid-on, he decides against a single
rocks back and taps it softly in front of mid-on and takes a quick single
too short and too wide outside off, Agarkar wasn't chasing that
too short and Agarkar reaches out and upper cuts it over Munaf's head at third man
very good bouncer, Agarkar gets down and holds the periscope out as the ball sails over his head
Watson holds the length back on seeing Agarkar make room for himself, he chops it down towards cover
hops back and steers one towards point and sets off, he decides against the single and scampers back
gets it to kick up off a good length and he hops and places it down to third man
lovely shot, Tanvit pitches it up on middle and the ball holds its line, Agarkar swiftly lofts through the line and carts the ball just over the rope on the straight boundary
hits a length outside off, he gets across and places it towards cover
slides wide down the legside and Agarkar almost rehearses the uppish flick as the ball beats him

the offstump tumbles... Tanvir pitches it outside off and gets it to nip back in a little, Butt drives away from his body, fails to cover the line and gets a thick inside edge which cannons onto his offstump, as usual Tanvir shows no emotion
pitches outside off and dips back in, he shoulders arms
loses his line there as he slides down the leg side, he misses the glance
this was a little wide outside off and Ganguly angles it wide of the slips and Watson slides well at third man and saves a boundary
superb timing from Ganguly as he reaches out and effortlessly drives a fullish delivery wide of point
slides down the leg side, Butt gets a big shuffle across and turns it wide of square leg, that flew off the face of the bat
pitches in line with the pads and Ganguly only manages to nudge it off his hips
misdirects the bouncer and strays wide down the legside, he withdraws his stroke
stays on the backfoot and punches this firmly towards mid-on, dive restricts this to a single
gets across and defends to the offside
Dropped: How simple was that? Butt chips one off his pads tamely and Niraj Patel at midwicket mistimes his jump and makes a royal mess of it. Could be a costly drop
starts off with a full delivery on the pads, he whips it wide of midwicket to get off the mark
